line: A baker's boy chases a runaway loaf downhill, then breaks it in half for a hungry girl.
line_cn: 面包店学徒追一个滚走的面包，最后掰成两半分给饿肚子的小女孩。

camera.serves: a mechanical gag; a crowd; an elaborate process
a chase; a race; a delivery against the clock

transitions: Transitions: iris, fade to black, straight cuts, the curtain.
No dissolves between shots of the same scene, no modern whip pans.
labels: The intertitles are the subtitles; the .srt lists their text. A card holds 2.5–3.75 s (≥ max(1.8 s, reading time + 0.6 s)).

A black painted card with a deco border whose ornament follows the emotion: one heavy rule for a shout (the text shakes), a double rule with stepped corners and fans for narration, vines and small flowers for tenderness.
Period faces (OFL): a small-caps display serif (e.g. Playfair Display SC) for titles and shouts, an italic old-style serif (e.g. Old Standard TT Italic) for narration and dialogue.
A few words per card; three to five cards in a short film. A card never explains what the picture already shows.
motion: Hand-cranked sampling: character and camera motion sampled at 16 fps (18 or more to undercrank a fast scene); flicker, weave, grain and scratches change every output frame (24 fps). That mix makes it look projected rather than merely low-frame-rate.
Speed is an emotion: undercrank chases and panic (faster motion, faster flicker); return to 16 fps and a calmer print for tender scenes.

Deadpan performance: the face barely changes; the body acts (crouch before effort, held poses, the two-frame snap of a double take, hands on knees). Objects act too (a wobble before a fall, a ritardando to rest).
Keyframed, eased poses; only deliberate gags snap.

native_moves.name: The chain in one take
native_moves.does: A triggers B, B leaves the frame, the audience waits, B returns and hits C.
native_moves.fits: a supply chain gone wrong; how a rumour spreads; a Rube Goldberg invention.

native_moves.name: The near-miss
native_moves.does: A hand closes exactly where the object was a frame ago.
native_moves.fits: catching a bus; a startup missing a deal; a goalkeeper.

native_moves.name: The intertitle twist
native_moves.does: A card reframes the next shot in a few words.
native_moves.fits: "Meanwhile, in the lab…"; "The machine had other ideas."; a statistic as a punchline.

native_moves.name: Undercranked chaos
native_moves.fits: rush hour; a kitchen at dinner service; a stock crash.

native_moves.name: Iris on the look
native_moves.does: An iris stops half-way so a character can glance at the audience.
native_moves.fits: a product winking; a cat that knows; a scientist's secret.

native_moves.name: Redrawn footage
native_moves.does: Real video pushed through the ink pass becomes a period drawing.
native_moves.fits: a company's archive; a family film; a sports clip.

native_moves.name: The echo gesture
native_moves.does: A gesture from the start repeated by someone else with a new meaning.
native_moves.fits: a teacher and a pupil; a handover; a tradition.

score.note: an upright piano plays every event: stride left hand, mood sections
